context: A boss explains corporate finance basics to a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 残高/納税/人件/同行/職種/命じ/多額/持ち出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮くん、企業の残高決算、職種別に分解して見ると面白いよ。
lines.en: Ren, you know what's interesting? When you break down corporate financials by department, you start to see real patterns.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Leans back slightly — comfortable in his own knowledge. Pauses after the name to check in. Genuine curiosity in his voice, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人件費の重みも、職種で違うんですね。
lines.en: So the weight of labor costs really does shift depending on the department.
lines.style: Quiet discovery in the voice. Speaks slowly, as if following the logic in real-time. Slight upward lift at the end — checking that he's understood correctly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 納税の構造も、業種ごとに違う。多額の控除も時に。
lines.en: Tax structures shift by industry too. And sometimes there are significant deductions built into that.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, steady rhythm. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No rush. The tone of someone explaining something he's thought about many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 資料、社外への持ち出しは厳禁ですよね。
lines.en: Materials absolutely can't leave the office, right? That's the rule.
lines.style: Gentle anxiety underneath. Voice tightens slightly on 'can't.' Seeking confirmation, not challenging. The careful politeness of someone still learning the boundaries.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当然だ。役員にも命じてある、社外同行時のルール遵守。
lines.en: Of course. I've made it clear to all the executives — we follow protocol when anything goes outside these walls.
lines.style: Definitive. Clipped slightly on 'of course.' Weight on 'clear' and 'protocol.' Not harsh, but firm — this is settled ground. The voice of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I really appreciate that. This has been really valuable.
lines.style: Sincere and warm. Soft voice, like the words are genuine and not performed. Small pause before 'really' the second time — he means it. Slight bow in the voice.
